verdictLine: CLOSED WITH FOLLOW-UPS: R4-1 is closed. Every row that changed against 7823e68 in five mulberry32 runs (802,188 rows) is a straight " after a digit that is now ″, and each equals 03dd4f3 and 7823e68 with R3-3 undone; none is worse. Byte-identical, HTML5, idempotence, linear time, speed and run-all hold. New follow-ups FU1 to FU3 (a cache-key mutant survives the suite; a pre-existing en-GB single-outer mixed-mark output; tidy-ups). R4-2 to R4-6 carry forward.

R4-1.evidence:
The three prose repros (gate-x5n4/prose-own.tsv rows 31, 32 and 76) give 27″ at 0bb7844, typed and depth, where 7823e68 gives 27’. Of the 210 prose rows, 6 differ from 7823e68 (exactly those three rows in two modes), 8 differ from 9822af0 (the receipt’s 14 less these 6), and 0 are unstable on a second pass. The 28 generated rows the receipt names (own atoms, mulberry32 seed 31, N 600, MAXLEN 11, 158,634 rows) are the same 28 rows, by config and input, that now change; each gives 9822af0’s output, its only change is ’ to ″, and the fix’s total against 9822af0 drops from 182 to 154. nl double-outer was not affected by R4-1 (7823e68 already gives 27″ there; its corpus case passes on the old code), and gives 27″. Through Craft (the testbed’s mounted plugin, gate-x5n4/craft-probe.txt): nl → 27″, en-GB single-outer → 27″. The R3-3 cases stay green (the suite passes 3860), and undoing the fix (M1) fails exactly three r4-1 cases. R4-1 reached further than the receipt said: any locale where a curly ‘…’ is the innermost quotation inside an open double quotation. en-US

“We waited ‘til 6 and saw a 27" set in the fans’ lounge.

gave 27” at 7823e68 (and at 9822af0) and now gives 27″, as 03dd4f3 did. The fix covers it, and the targeted runs below found it in en-US, en-GB, da, es, es guillemets-outer, nb, nl double-outer and pt as well.

notBlocking.summary:
Not new in this fix, and not new since 9822af0: in en-GB single-outer, a straight ' inside a curly ‘ quotation that sits inside an open “ quotation can close the “ quotation as ”, whether it is a foot mark or a plural possessive.

“He said ‘the dogs' bowls are full,” she said. “And ‘the set is 27" wide in the players’ lounge.

→ dogs”;

“He said ‘I am 6' tall,” she said. “And ‘the set is 27" wide in the players’ lounge.

→ 6”;

“He said ‘I own a 27" telly and I am 6' tall in the players’ lounge.

→ 6”. 0bb7844, 7823e68 and 9822af0 agree; 03dd4f3 gives dogs’, 6’ or 6′, so these are rows of the round-3 back-out, which re-check 3 accepted as intended. The README Known limit “A straight mark closing a curly quotation of another shape” may cover them, but its example is a real closing mark, not a possessive or a foot mark.
